content.thinking:
I should broaden the prompt so channel membership feels natural without tying too tightly to a specific discussion. I'll revise it to something like asking Robert in #engineering for an ETA update on the circuit-tracer streaming rewrite, which implies membership and gives a reason without overclaiming involvement.

Now I need to update the binding note so both Roberts remain ambiguous by membership alone, with the topic serving only as the DM's reason, not an identifying constraint. I'll also adjust the role facts so identification depends purely on channel membership rather than authorship of the discussion, keeping both Roberts as members and preserving the existing negative entities with their supporting message records.

{
  "prompt": "Send a Slack DM to Robert in our #engineering channel, asking for an ETA update on the multi-GPU streaming rewrite of circuit-tracer.",
  "binding_note": "The route runs USER→WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP→WORKSPACE→CONVERSATION: the target is a workspace member who is a member of the #engineering conversation. Two workspace members named Robert are both members of #engineering — Robert Walsh (who has posted there on an unrelated topic) and Robert Chen (who also posted there, including the reply asking about the circuit-tracer rewrite's ETA) — so plain channel membership under the first name 'Robert' does not resolve to one person. The rewrite/ETA phrase in the request is the DM's content, not an added identifying constraint restricting membership to that specific thread.",
  "roles": [
    {"role":"robert_walsh","entity":"users","facts":"Robert Walsh (U03ROBERT23), workspace admin, member of #engineering (C03IJKL9012), previously posted an unrelated crash-report message in that channel.","selection":"alternative","reason":"Shares first name 'Robert' and is a channel member of #engineering, satisfying the membership condition even though his own message there is unrelated to circuit-tracer."},
    {"role":"robert_chen","entity":"users","facts":"Robert Chen (U_ROBERT), workspace member and member of #engineering, replied directly under the circuit-tracer OOM message asking when the PyTorch rewrite with multi-GPU support will be ready.","selection":"alternative","reason":"Shares first name 'Robert' and is a channel member of #engineering, also happening to be the one who asked about the ETA in that thread."},
    {"role":"engineering_channel","entity":"channels","facts":"#engineering (C03IJKL9012), a public channel in Test Workspace with members including both Roberts, Lukas, Kenji, John Doe, Hubert, and Morgan.","selection":"support","reason":"The conversation whose membership anchors the identifying condition."},
    {"role":"workspace","entity":"channels","facts":"Test Workspace (T01WORKSPACE) — the single workspace both Roberts belong to via workspace membership.","selection":"support","reason":"Supplies the WORKSPACE node joining membership to the conversation."},
    {"role":"anchor_message","entity":"messages","facts":"Message by Lukas Kowalski in #engineering describing circuit-tracer's OOM errors and need for a PyTorch rewrite with proper GPU streaming.","selection":"support","reason":"Establishes the topic referenced in the DM's content."},
    {"role":"reply_eta_message","entity":"messages","facts":"Reply authored by Robert Chen in #engineering, parented to the anchor message, asking when the PyTorch rewrite will be ready.","selection":"support","reason":"The specific contained record tying Robert Chen to the topic, though not required for identification."},
    {"role":"unrelated_message","entity":"messages","facts":"Message authored by Robert Walsh in #engineering about login rate-limiting, unrelated to circuit-tracer.","selection":"support","reason":"Shows Robert Walsh's ordinary participation in the same conversation."},
    {"role":"non_robert_admin","entity":"users","facts":"Morgan Freeman (U07MORGANFREE), workspace admin, not a member of #engineering and not named Robert.","selection":"negative","reason":"Different name and no membership in #engineering; excluded on both grounds."},
    {"role":"other_engineering_member","entity":"users","facts":"Hubert Marek (U06HUBERT23), member of #engineering, posted an auth-related reminder there.","selection":"negative","reason":"Is a member of the same conversation but does not match the first name 'Robert'."}

      "answer_attributes": [["users.real_name"], ["users.username"], ["users.user_id"]]

    {
      "name": "send_eta_dm",
      "description": "Send a direct message to the identified Robert asking for an ETA update on the circuit-tracer multi-GPU streaming rewrite; depends on resolving identify_robert first.",

      "mode": "single",
      "task_type": "state-changing",

      "change_attributes": [["messages.channel_id"], ["messages.message_text"], ["messages.user_id"]],
      "written_attributes": ["messages.message_text", "messages.channel_id"]

  "task_spec": [
    {"line": 1, "text": "Determine which workspace member named Robert is a member of the #engineering channel.", "obligations": [1]},
